Duration constant

You and your Feral Bond both count as flanking your Marked quarry whenever you are both within 30 feet of it and both able to see it, regardless of where either of you stands relative to the other.

cinderfall.incomplete: Constant: you and your Feral Bond both count as flanking your Marked quarry whenever both are within 30ft and able to see it, regardless of relative position. The only real, buildable piece found is system.attributes.flanking.canGangUp = true (matches pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/rogue/level-6/gang-up.json), but it is a strictly broader grant than this card describes: real canGangUp makes flanking-without-opposite-positions work with ANY ally against ANY enemy, at reach (not a fixed 30-ft range), permanently -- with no predicate hook to scope it down to "only this one companion, only against my current Mark, only within 30 feet" (it is a single global boolean, not a predicated modifier). Shipping it as-is would silently grant Waywardens a broader, unconditional version of the ability the card text restricts three separate ways, so it is left unshipped. This is the research draft's own Open Question #1, explicitly left unresolved for the owner to call rather than guessed at: ship the real-but-overbroad canGangUp flag, or leave this fully unbuilt until/unless a predicated version becomes possible. Also blocked independently by NO-MARK ("your Marked quarry" has no Foundry-schema footprint yet).
